    'days_to_last_followup', 'pharmaceutical_therapy', 'pathologic_stage'
])
df_clin = df_clin.rename(columns={'bcr_patient_barcode': 'patient'})
# Fill missing event and treatments
for col in ['new_tumor_event','pharmaceutical_therapy']:
    df_clin[col] = df_clin[col].fillna('NO')
# Time and event
df_clin['time'] = np.where(
    df_clin['new_tumor_event']=='YES', df_clin['days_to_new_tumor'], df_clin['days_to_last_followup']
)
df_clin['event'] = (df_clin['new_tumor_event']=='YES').astype(int)
# Drop missing time or stage
df_clin = df_clin.dropna(subset=['time','pathologic_stage'])

# Group pathologic stage into two strata
low_stages = {'Stage I','Stage IA','Stage IB','Stage II','Stage IIA','Stage IIB'}
high_stages = set(df_clin['pathologic_stage']) - low_stages
df_clin['stage_high'] = df_clin['pathologic_stage'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x in high_stages else 0)
print(f"Stage groups: I-II: {sum(df_clin['stage_high']==0)}, III-IV: {sum(df_clin['stage_high']==1)}")
print(f"Events by stage group: I-II: {df_clin.loc[df_clin['stage_high']==0,'event'].sum()}, III-IV: {df_clin.loc[df_clin['stage_high']==1,'event'].sum()}")

# Load and preprocess gene expression data
gene_expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
# Strip Ensembl version
gene_expr.index = gene_expr.index.to_series().str.split('.').str[0]
# Harmonize sample IDs to patient barcodes
gene_expr.columns = gene_expr.columns.to_series().apply(lambda x: '-'.join(x.split('-')[:3]))
# Subset to patients present in clinical
common = sorted(set(df_clin['patient']).intersection(gene_expr.columns))
if not common:
    raise ValueError("No overlap between clinical and expression data.")
print(f"Matched patients: {len(common)}")
gene_expr = gene_expr[common]

# Map proliferation genes to Ensembl IDs
targets = {'MKI67':'ENSG00000148773','PCNA':'ENSG00000153029','TOP2A':'ENSG00000131747'}
missing = [eid for eid in targets.values() if eid not in gene_expr.index]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing Ensembl IDs: {missing}")
# Extract and rename rows
gene_sig = gene_expr.loc[list(targets.values())]
gene_sig.index = list(targets.keys())
# Compute proliferation score
expr_z = gene_sig.apply(lambda x: (x - x.mean())/x.std(ddof=0), axis=1)
prolif_score = expr_z.T.mean(axis=1).rename('proliferation_score')

# Build model dataframe with covariates: proliferation_score, pharma, stage_high

plt.xlabel('Days')
plt.ylabel('Survival Probability')
plt.tight_layout()
